name: compassion
description: Compassion Switzerland: optional Claude Code plugins for Odoo work. Install the ones you want, or compassion-starter for all of them.

plugins.name: compassion-starter
plugins.description: Everything below in one install: find-docs, agent-browser and assisted-by.

plugins.name: find-docs
plugins.description: Current docs for any library through Context7, and Odoo docs pinned to your repository's Odoo version.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: A real Chrome Claude drives to check your local Odoo: screenshots, console errors, forms.

plugins.name: assisted-by
plugins.description: An Assisted-by: <model id>, <effort>, claude-code trailer on every commit Claude makes.
